rule_implemented_v2p8_1_unchanged_v2p8_2.v: abort OVER_THRUST when 3 consecutive fresh FC_THRUST frames carry the valid flag and a value > 650 N while the ECU is in RUN in FLIGHT mode; fresh = received within 50 ms of the previous one (+1 us slack); the count restarts on a frame <= threshold, a frame with the flag clear, a gap > 50 ms or leaving RUN; the abort is taken on the tick that receives the 3rd frame and drops the MV latch drive on that tick

hil_plan.setup: flight FC and flight ECU (Teensy 4.1 build) on the bench harness, flight CAN at 1 Mbit/s with the flight stub lengths and terminations; CAN analyser with hardware timestamps (<= 1 us); 8-channel logic analyser / scope on IMU DR, FC read GPIO, FC decision GPIO, ECU MVL_G, latch coil current, MV-P position switch; MV-P on its bench rig (B-MV-1, flowing water or N2 per Mechanical)
stimulus: (a) SPI replay of sim6 F_acc traces into the FC estimator input (FC test hook): steps 500 -> 876 N, ramps 2500 / 3600 N/s from 150 and 500 N, healthy 571.5 N maxima for the no-trip check
(b) flight IMU on a step fixture for E0/E1 (B-FC-1)
(c) FC_THRUST frames injected by the analyser directly to the ECU for E5/E6 alone (B-ECU-1)
hil_plan.measure: each term as an edge-to-edge time; 1000 repetitions per stimulus; report mean, p99, max
hil_plan.pass: every measured term <= its budget max (or its allocation); end-to-end p99 <= the sum; no trip on the healthy replay; a term over budget is reported with its measured value and goes back to the owner
hil_plan.not_covered: airframe axial modes and combustion oscillation (E10): T1-T4 hot fires

common_time_base.need: T1-T4 compare F_acc (FC) with the load cell (stand DAQ) and the ECU log; today the FC, ECU and DAQ clocks are independent (open issue)
common_time_base.proposal: the stand DAQ records the CAN bus through the analyser on the DAQ clock (FC_THRUST and TLM frames timestamped on the same clock as the load cell) and one ECU GPIO sync pulse (1 Hz, edge logged by the ECU tick counter and by the DAQ); the FC logs its CAN TX timestamps; residual alignment <= 1 ms [DESIGN]
common_time_base.logging: load cell >= 1 kHz anti-aliased, F_acc at the FC frame rate plus its raw IMU samples, low-frequency content 5-200 Hz retained (no high-pass) for RG-19 second action
common_time_base.owner: Electronics (stand DAQ, ECU sync) + FC owner (FC log) + GNC (analysis)
